text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

You're a man, the successful candidate is a man, and the panel was all men — so the panel's composition points away from, not toward, sex being the reason you were passed over. Raising it would read as grasping and would weaken the parts of your case that actually have substance.

Focus instead on what's genuinely arguable: you appear to have the stronger formal qualifications (PhD vs. master's) and eight years of section leadership, while "broad leadership experience" is vague and unevidenced. That raises fair questions about whether the criteria were defined in advance and applied consistently.

Your real grievance is procedural. Send a written follow-up citing your original request and set a deadline.
